integrity: Explicit formulas and complete proof; the companion checker evaluates exact rational finite cases. No external or independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The constructive counterexample concerns the standard unweighted one-dimensional Bergman disk. The real radial L1 symbol may change sign even though its Toeplitz operator is positive. No assertion of optimal norm constants, nonnegative-symbol extension, higher-dimensional extension, or priority beyond inspected sources is made. Infinite-dimensional results rely on analytic proofs; finite checks are supplementary.
title: Radial integrable Toeplitz symbols with invisible essential norm
